ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Fraud: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the Feeding Our Future nonprofit and its leader Aimee Bock, who were involved in a $40 million fraud scheme.
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail and examine the nonprofit's operations and connections.
ideas.insight: This story could reveal broader issues with nonprofit oversight and fraud prevention in Minnesota.

ideas.title: The Impact of Medicaid Cuts in Minnesota
ideas.description: Explore the effects of impending Medicaid cuts on Minnesota residents and healthcare providers.
ideas.angle: Analyze the data and speak with affected parties to understand the real-world implications.
questions: How many people will be affected?
What are the potential health consequences?
ideas.insight: This story could highlight the human cost of policy changes and potential solutions.
